versions.changelog:
- Merge pull request #2 from patello/migrate-weight-to-measure
- Migrate body weight to measurement system, single source of truth
- Require python3 for skill and update CLI reference
- Clarify pre-seeded default measurement types in README and SKILL.md
- Add notes field support to individual measurements
- Implement dynamic and extensible body measurements with custom units and descriptions
- feat: implement grouping by default for list and stats day commands, add --no-group flag

- Simplify weekly stats averages and budgets and add --include-today flag
- Sort stats chronological ascending and place diff after cm/kg value
- Adjust stats weight and waist default to -N 5, supporting entries and days combinations
- Add global --today CLI option to simulate dates and update stats and logging commands
- ci: enable dynamic changelog generation from git history
